answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 10639 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalamualaikum Q)Allah Azzawajal wages war on three kinds of people in the Quran who are the three types of people could you please explain in detail? Question: Assalamualaikum Q)Allah Azzawajal wages war on three kinds of people in the Quran who are the three types of people could you please explain in detail? Answer ID: 10639 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 249/249=M/1430) The Quran clearly states that Allah declares war against one who involves in transaction of interest. Also, there is hadith which says: ?One who has enmity with the wali of Allah, Allah declares war against him.? But, I saw no other thing related to the matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
